summary: Complaints centre on missing sewer lines and waterlogging in Sorkha and Chhajarsi villages, floodplain power cuts in Chhajarsi and Chotpur, and VIP-movement traffic jams in Noida city, while appreciation focuses on new sewer, road and pond projects in the villages and the Sector 51-52 metro skywalk.

positives.english: Metro skywalk between Sector 51 and 52 is open now, easier to reach the station
positives.hindi: सेक्टर-51 और 52 के बीच मेट्रो स्काईवॉक खुल गया, आना-जाना आसान
positives.basis: Rs 36.90 crore skywalk between Sector-52 Blue Line and Sector-51 Aqua Line metro stations; trial opening in August, official inauguration on 4 Oct 2026. Sector 51-52 is in Noida city, which the AC Wikipedia extent covers ('It consists of the city of Noida').

positives.english: A Rs 9.82 crore pond is being built in Sorkha, half the work is done
positives.hindi: सोरखा में 9.82 करोड़ का तालाब बन रहा है, आधा काम हो चुका है
positives.basis: Pushkaneer pond at Sorkha Jahidabad, cost about Rs 9.82 crore, about 50% complete, expected to finish in about four months; aim is water conservation and groundwater recharge. Sorkha Jahidabad is named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

positives.english: Sewer projects for Chhajarsi and Baraula villages have been launched
positives.hindi: छजारसी और बरौला में सीवर परियोजना का शिलान्यास हो गया
positives.basis: Foundation laid on 14 May 2026 for sewer works in Chhajarsi (Rs 165.13 lakh, 1,280 m new sewer line in three lanes) and a 10 MLD sewage pumping station in Baraula (Rs 978.68 lakh). The article does not state completion. Chhajarsi and Baraula are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

positives.english: A new panchayat ghar has been built and opened in Naya Bans, Sector 15
positives.hindi: नया बांस गांव में नया पंचायत घर बनकर तैयार हो गया
positives.basis: New village panchayat ghar in Naya Bans, Sector 15, Noida, opened on 12 Sep 2026; article gives construction cost of about Rs 230.86 lakh. Sector 15 is in Noida city (AC extent: 'It consists of the city of Noida').

positives.english: Sixteen road and drain works are going on in Chhajarsi and Chotpur
positives.hindi: छजारसी और चोटपुर में सड़क और नाली के 16 काम हो रहे हैं
positives.basis: About Rs 4.23 crore for 16 road and drain projects in Chhijarsi, Chotpur, Bahlolpur and Garhi Chaukhandi, funded from MLA fund and other schemes. Article mixes foundation and inauguration and does not confirm which works are finished; completion status unconfirmed. Chhajarsi and Chotpur are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: No sewer line in Sorkha for 20 years, even light rain floods the main road
negatives.hindi: सोरखा में 20 साल से सीवर लाइन शुरू नहीं, हल्की बारिश में सड़क पर पानी
negatives.basis: Sorkha village (Sector-115, Noida): without a sewer line, light rain floods the main roads (Amar Ujala, 30 Apr 2026); Bharatiya Kisan Union Kranti state president warned of agitation and said the authority's chaupal was a formality. Villagers said a sewer line laid about 20 years ago has still not been started, and the main road is too damaged for sanitation tankers (Amar Ujala video, 3 Jan 2025). Sorkha Jahidabad is named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: Power cut for floodplain homes in Chhajarsi and Chotpur, residents want 24-hour supply
negatives.hindi: डूब क्षेत्र में बिजली काट दी, अब 24 घंटे बिजली भी नहीं मिलती
negatives.basis: Residents of Chijarsi, Chotpur and Behlolpur floodplain say hundreds of connections were cut over four days (ETV Bharat, 1 Sep 2026); they demand 24-hour power and permanent meters. The electricity department gave no comment in the article. Power department elsewhere cited theft and illegal connections as the reason; that is not reported here. Chhajarsi and Chotpur are named in the AC Wikipedia extent.

negatives.english: Hours-long jams from Mahamaya flyover to Sector 51 whenever VIPs pass
negatives.hindi: वीआईपी दौरे पर महामाया फ्लाईओवर से सेक्टर-51 तक घंटों जाम
negatives.basis: On 24 Sep 2026 a VIP movement caused jams from Mahamaya Flyover to Sector 51 (also Chilla Border and Dalit Prerna Sthal), with peak jams 7-10 am and 4-9 pm (Amar Ujala). Episodic, but traffic is named as a recurring Noida seat issue in a 2026 analysis (tnpnews). Noida city is covered by the AC extent.

negatives.english: Sector 43 water supply keeps breaking, sewers stay blocked
negatives.hindi: सेक्टर-43 में पानी की सप्लाई बार-बार रुकती है, सीवर भी जाम रहता है
negatives.basis: Sector 43 residents: frequent water supply disruptions left entire blocks dry for hours; sewage blockages spread during the monsoon; streetlights broken (ThePrint, 28 Dec 2025). The article does not name the assembly seat; Sector 43 is in Noida city, covered by the AC extent.

negatives.english: Sector 31 has open drains and waterlogging
negatives.hindi: सेक्टर-31 में नाले खुले हैं और जलभराव की शिकायत है
negatives.basis: Review meeting at Sector-27 club on 1 Apr 2026: officials were told to cover drains, clear waterlogging and clean the UGR in C-Block of Sector-31. Local outlet report; the assembly seat is not named in the article; Sector 31 is in Noida city, covered by the AC extent.

notes: AC identity confirmed from the Wikipedia UP constituency list: No. 61, Noida, district Gautam Budh Nagar (spelled 'Gautam Budh Nagar' there), reserved: None. The AC Wikipedia page's area list includes Sorkha Jahidabad, Chhajarsi, Chotpur, Baraula, Mamura, Jalpura, Sultanpur, Sadarpur and Salarpur Noida, and says the AC 'consists of the city of Noida'. Sector-level items (Sectors 15, 31, 43, 51-52) are inside Noida city, so they rely on that line; none of the sector-level sources names the AC itself, so a field check is advisable. Sorkha video is from Jan 2025 and is older than the other sources. Excluded: Greater Noida West (Dadri AC), Nagla Jahanu and Tirthali (Yamuna City/Jewar area, not in the AC extent), Sector 130/Nangli Wajidpur sewer work (AC membership not confirmed), a ncrkhabar report whose 50,000-people figure is unattributed, and an old Chhajarsi drain report whose date and URL I could not confirm. Traffic evidence is thin (one dated VIP-jam report plus analysis); a field check of recurring Noida city jams would strengthen it. Positives 1-5 are mostly project launches or status-unconfirmed items; only the metro skywalk and the Naya Bans panchayat ghar are clearly delivered. MLA-linked works are described without naming politicians in the statements.
